lines.text: But wait until you see what happens when they land.
On Earth, gravity squeezes your spine all day long.
In orbit, that squeeze is gone, and the spine stretches out.
The soft discs between the bones can puff up with fluid.
Astronauts can grow up to three percent taller. For a tall adult, that's about five centimeters.

lines.text: Then they land, and gravity squeezes them right back to normal.
Sounds fake? It's true. Follow for more.
